title: A Privileged Teacher That Only Scores Cannot Search: Critique-Conditioned On-Policy Self-Distillation for Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2610.13744v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: On-policy self-distillation promises to replace the sparse outcome signal of verifiable-reward RL with dense token-level credit: a teacher conditioned on the reference solution scores the student's own rollout, and the resulting distributional shift is distilled back into the policy. We investigate whether this scoring signal actually contains corrective credit. Using gold error spans in student rollouts, we test the two signals consumed by self-distillation objectives, the full-distribution KL and the token log-ratio, for two properties: whether they localize errors and whether they push probability away from erroneous student tokens. They exhibit neither of these properties nor can they reliably distinguish correct from incorrect rollouts within the same problem. We argue that this failure is structural: locating an error in a reasoning trace is itself a search problem, while a scoring teacher is never explicitly asked to perform that

translated_title: 只会打分而不会搜索的特权教师：面向推理的批评条件化在策略自蒸馏
translated_abstract: 在策略自蒸馏有望用密集的token级信用信号取代可验证奖励强化学习中稀疏的结果信号：一个以参考解为条件的教师对学生在策略生成的rollout进行评分，由此产生的分布偏移再被蒸馏回策略中。我们研究这种评分信号是否真的包含纠正性信用。利用学生rollout中的黄金错误区间，我们检验了自蒸馏目标所依赖的两种信号——全分布KL散度和token对数比——是否具备两个关键性质：能否定位错误，以及能否将概率从错误的学生token上推开。结果表明，这两种信号均不具备上述性质，也无法在同一问题内可靠地区分正确与错误的rollout。我们认为这种失败是结构性的：在推理轨迹中定位错误本身就是一个搜索问题，而评分教师从未被明确要求执行这一任务。
tldr: 本文发现自蒸馏中的评分信号既无法定位学生推理中的错误，也无法可靠区分正确与错误的rollout，并指出错误定位本质上是搜索问题，因而提出批评条件化的在策略自蒸馏方法来弥补“只会打分、不会搜索”的评分教师的结构性缺陷。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that scoring signals in on-policy self-distillation neither localize student errors nor reliably distinguish correct from incorrect rollouts, arguing that error localization is inherently a search problem, and proposes critique-conditioned on-policy self-distillation to overcome the structural limitation of a scoring-only teacher.
